title: Go-live Handoff Cue Sheet
body:
Purpose:
This is a lightweight, operational cue sheet for the final 10 business days before a planned go-live.
It is intended to be used as a shared single-page runbook for Product Ops, Eng SRE, Release Eng, and Solutions to coordinate handoff tasks, acceptance KPIs, and immediate fallback triggers.

How to use this doc:
- Owner (Product Ops) runs daily 15m stand from T-10 through T+3.
- Mark items GREEN/AMB/RED in sync; escalate RED to SRE/Oncall and product owner.
- Use the Velocity Sentinel table (below) to decide capacity and feature cut decisions.

KeyContacts:
- Product Ops (owner): Priya Kapoor (pri@redwood.ai)
- Release Eng: Evan Chen (evan@redwood.ai)
- SRE Oncall: Diego Morales (pager: DiegoM)
- Solutions/CS escalation: Asha Raman

Handoff windows (pick one):
- Overnight soft cut (02:00-04:00 PT) — lower user impact but smaller maintenance window.
- Weekend main (Sat 00:00–06:00 PT) — recommended for schema/data migrations.
- Rolling canary (progressive, 1% -> 100% over 6h) — best for zero-downtime if feature supports canary flags.

Pre-Launch checklist (T-10 -> T-1):
- T-10: Feature freeze affirmed; no new PRs without release owner signoff.
- T-9: Final acceptance tests passing (smoke, e2e, perf). Link: confluence:PROD-QA-acceptance
- T-7: Capacity plan signed (expected qps, p50/p95 targets, burst patterns).
- T-6: Rollback playbook drafted and validated in staging.
- T-4: Customer comms draft approved (beta + public segments).
- T-3: Observability dashboards in place and dashboard owners assigned.
- T-2: Run simulated pressure test at 110% expected peak for 15m.
- T-1: Readiness vote (Product Ops, Release Eng, SRE) — unanimous GREEN required to proceed.

Go/No-Go gating KPIs (must be GREEN to proceed):
- Stability: error-rate < 0.5% over baseline 30m window in staging and canary.
- Latency: p95 latency within 1.25x of baseline for steady workloads.
- Throughput: sustained QPS within 90–110% of capacity plan artifacts.
- Regression: no new severity-1 regressions in last 48h.
- Cost budget guardrail: projected 7-day token cost estimate within committed budget +10%.

Velocity Sentinel (roadmap runway tracker) — use to decide feature cuts and roll size:
Columns: week | planned pts | completed pts | runway multiplier | action
- W-3 | 120 | 92 | 0.77 | Consider deferring noncritical backlog
- W-2 | 110 | 100 | 0.91 | Keep scope, but freeze non-blocking improvements
- W-1 |  80 | 78 | 0.98 | Proceed with canary; soft cut OK
Interpretation: runway multiplier <0.85 = risk zone (require scope reduction or extended staging).

Release traffic shaping and throttles:
- Initial ramp: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% at 30m intervals once KPIs are stable.
- Automatic throttle triggers: p95 latency > 2x baseline OR error-rate > 1% for 5m -> pause ramp and alert SRE.

Rollback thresholds (automatic and manual):
- Auto-rollback: if error-rate >5% sustained for 3m post-gradual-ramp -> automatic rollback to previous model/variant.
- Manual rollback: if customer-impacting regression confirmed by CS or SRE within 60m and no mitigation in 30m.

Communication templates (short):
- Beta group: "We are enabling feature X for your account on DATE. Expect brief degradation window during the 30m ramp. Reply to this thread to opt out"
- Internal incident stub: "Incident: [short title]
Impact: [users/paths]
Initial action: [rollback/mitigation]
Owner: [name]"

Acceptance evidence checklist (place links or YES/NO):
- Production smoke runbook executed: YES
- E2E tests on canary: YES
- Perf run logs attached: confluence:perf/W-9-stress
- Security signoff (pen test / threat model): YES

Open questions / subtle risk notes (notes-to-self style):
- Do we need a separate DB migration window if the canary sees schema drift? (If yes, schedule offline window.)
- Feature depends on downstream partner A; they reported flakiness at peak. Consider fallback route.
- Cost modeling for token spikes under rerolls is rough; keep contingency budget.

Post-launch T+1 -> T+14 checklist (first two weeks):
- T+1: Validate telemetry ingest, confirm no growth in customer errors.
- T+3: Run a smaller perf test (50% peak) and compare to pre-launch baselines.
- T+7: Team retrospective + adoption signals snapshot.
- T+14: Decide on full rollout or staged expansion (if canary used).

Quick links and artifacts:
- Runbooks: confluence:runbooks/feature-x
- Deployment pipeline: github:repo/actions/deploy.yaml
- Capacity plan spreadsheet: sheets:capacity/feature-x-Q4
- Incident channel: slack:#prod-launch

Notes to owner (Priya):
- Keep this doc intentionally short. Make a copy per-release and append the release tag and result.
- If any gating KPI flips red, annotate timestamp and owner who acknowledged.

EOF
